body: DURABLE DOCS CANDIDATE — cand-651HHATHXTN6XCXVZWRPXV4J4B, exact commit da203a8fe26c7d2fb359296e5cf2eb9bddfb697b over base 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5; only vision.md and mission.md. It implements the six current-state amendments and reconciles them with Chief's later closure of O1-O4: evidence chain or typed absence/outcome/provenance; future film as synchronized non-equivalent observation axes; output as a manifest bundle around canonical StoryModelCodec bytes with three text identities, typed Unestablished denominator refusal, independent semantic/report/lowering outcomes, and provenance-derived ViewBasis; geometry explicitly not identity; deterministic textual twins scoped to produced scientific visual reports; graph-over-text entered as a bounded drawn spike rather than presumed adequate; second materially different narrative fixture required before a generality claim. The local-open clause is the owner minimum only: obvious preview.html, no build step, terminal command, local server, or installation. It does NOT claim no-JS or network independence. Exact docs court passed (evid-9b04651b232d1b5fd64c775e55a709d8d15cb6c698e343fe04b1bfae40421aba): two paths only, diff check clean, <=100 columns, required contract clauses present; no runtime/browser claim.
